title: Functional Tensor Trains for High-Order Greeks and Exposure Tails of Multi-Asset Structured Products
abstract: arXiv:2610.42119v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Risk management of worst-of autocallables needs price sensitivities (Greeks) up to third order and the potential future exposure, a tail quantile of the note's future value. In Monte Carlo, each order of differentiation multiplies the sampling noise by a factor that grows with the observation frequency, and nested simulation turns the noise of its inner paths into a bias of the quantile. We instead solve the backward pricing recursion, storing the continuation value as an $hp$ functional tensor train (hp-FTT) whose piecewise-polynomial cores are split at the barriers, so that worst-of barrier events act exactly, with rank one. For Gaussian transitions we show that the polynomial degree sufficient for an error $\varepsilon$ grows only as $\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}$. One solve then gives every Greek at any spot without sampling noise, by integrating the likelihood-ratio weight against the stored value, and the values it stores at future d

translated_title: 面向多资产结构化产品高阶希腊字母与风险敞口尾部的函数张量列车
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.42119v1 公告类型： 新论文 摘要： 最差型自动赎回结构化票据的风险管理需要高达三阶的价格敏感度（希腊字母）以及潜在未来风险敞口，即票据未来价值的尾部分位数。在蒙特卡洛方法中，每增加一阶求导都会使采样噪声乘以一个随观察频率增长而增大的因子，而嵌套模拟则会将其内层路径的噪声转化为分位数估计的偏差。我们转而求解反向定价递归，将延续价值存储为 hp 函数张量列车（hp-FTT），其分段多项式核心在障碍位处进行切分，从而使最差型障碍事件能够以秩一的形式被精确处理。对于高斯转移，我们证明了达到误差 ε 所需的多项式阶数仅按 √(log(1/ε)) 的速度增长。一次求解即可通过将似然比权重与所存储的价值进行积分，在任意现货价格下得到所有希腊字母且无采样噪声，并且它所存储的未来日期的价值……
tldr: 本文提出 hp 函数张量列车（hp-FTT）方法，通过求解反向定价递归并以秩一形式精确处理最差型障碍事件，实现了多资产结构化产品（如最差型自动赎回票据）的高阶（三阶）希腊字母与潜在未来风险敞口尾部分位数的无采样噪声、高效且具理论误差保证的计算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an hp functional tensor train (hp-FTT) method that solves the backward pricing recursion with rank-one exact handling of worst-of barrier events, enabling noise-free, efficient, and theoretically guaranteed computation of high-order (up to third-order) Greeks and tail quantiles of potential future exposure for multi-asset structured products.
